query: An e-commerce platform has access to detailed revenue data for clothing products recorded in the ‘Revenue’ column. Each type of clothing has its own demand level influenced by factors such as seasonality and promotions. The retailer aims to maximize total revenue using the initial inventory provided in the ‘Initial Inventory’ column. Demand quantities are specified in the ‘Demand’ column and are assumed to be deterministic and known in advance. Decision variables x_i represent the number of units of each product that will be fulfilled.
